purpose: Type from the selected MDB master: native Media Composer access and classification, MDVx labels and override behavior, complete actual-MDB usage inventory and proposed Bella retention.
status: User approved Type rules on 20 October 2026: selected-master UsageCode 1 -> Precompute, 7 -> Media, blank display/export if unknown or unreadable. Not implemented; OldScanner active and Bin Filter unchanged. Original raw findings retain their pre-approval wording; agreedBellaRule records the final decision.

mediaComposer.scope: Bounded read-only arm64 static inspection for Bella MDB Type, meaning normal media versus precompute. This is separate from physical Audio/Video Kind and from optional precompute categories/effect labels. No application execution, native private API execution, media writes or production code edits.

fieldAndOwner.owner: The associated, already qualified master chosen for the physical file, using the approved complete-ID association rules. This fact belongs to the master composition, not the file own image/sound descriptor.
fieldAndOwner.type: Actual MDB corpus declares omfi:UsageCodeType; native getter/writer use signed Int32. The raw corpus agent independently checks declared type, four-byte width and object byte order.
fieldAndOwner.encoding: Binary numeric scalar, not text. No UTF-8 or MacRoman decoding is involved.
fieldAndOwner.nativeNaming: AComposition calls the in-memory member AppCode. GetAppCode returns the UsageCode-derived 32-bit member at +0x164.
notTheSameAs: MediaMuster MediaType enum values Unknown=-1, Media=0, Precompute=1 are application output values, not the wire UsageCode numbering.
Audio/Video Kind comes from the file descriptor. MobType is a separate native role qualifier. MDES:MobKind is a separate physical-source-kind concept.

anchors: 0x181540..60 selects the property dictionary and loads +0x2f0, OMFI:MOBJ:UsageCode.
0x183a9c stores the supplied int unchanged at +0x164 after the object dirty/update call. This setter does not prove every int is a supported UsageCode meaning.
0x180f5c..74 writes the +0x164 value to dictionary+0x2f0 through stream +0x158 WriteInt32 for the ordinary non-domain-5 path.

The domain-5 branch at0x180f34..54 writes precompute1 directly. Its later path0x181104..140 writes7 when AppCode7 or native MobType2 qualifies a master, otherwise writes the supplied value. This is a native domain-specific writer normalization, not a claim that MDB container version5 exists.

readWrite.function: Typed scalar bounds and byte order
anchors: ReadInt32 0xb7294 has the ordinary four-byte read and II-versus-other swapping behavior. Missing/unsupported/wrong-size paths may return0.
Bella must preserve the property read state; a missing or damaged word is not automatically a genuinely recorded zero or normal-media result.

nativeMainPredicates.evidence: The AComposition vtable address point0x122e540 slot+0x9e0 resolves exactly to GetMobType0x183ae4.

nativeMainPredicates.qualification: The zero case is accepted by this predicate only after role2 is established. It must not be generalized into every MDB zero/missing UsageCode being Media.

whyZeroIsNotAnUnconditionalMDBMediaRule.roleGetter: AComposition::GetMobType0x183ae4 returns the separate signed-byte member at+0x160. AComposition::Get loads it through the dictionary pseudo-property __OMFI:MOBJ:MobType, offset+0x16c8, and stream ReadChar.
pseudoPropertyBehavior: omfiDualStream::ReadChar0xb6f4c contains a special branch for native property code0x2d9 at0xb6f74..b7060. It can synthesize role3 when a cached descriptor-related property has a nonzero value length. This bounded receipt retains the exact cache access without claiming the pseudo-property is a stored one-byte MDB field.
Otherwise0xb7034..50 reads UsageCode and0xb7054..60 returns role2 for usage1 or7, role1 for other values.

Consequently the ordinary MDB pseudo-role path does not independently prove role2 for usage0. The separate predicate zero allowance can matter in other already qualified native contexts, but is not enough to add a blanket Bella mapping0→Media.
whyZeroIsNotAnUnconditionalMDBMediaRule.writerContext: The traced domain-5 writer also canonicalizes independently role2-qualified masters to UsageCode7. Neither that writer branch nor the predicate establishes a universal chronological old/new UsageCode schema.
whyZeroIsNotAnUnconditionalMDBMediaRule.bellaScope: For the currently qualified legacy MOBJ MDB layout, keep explicit usage1→Precompute and7→Media. A future supported layout with a separately proven master role and explicit0 needs its own evidence and policy; do not silently guess it here.

boundedOtherCompositionUsageMeanings.anchor: 0x27bd10..18 compares GetAppCode with2. Soft-subclip further checks _START/_END attributes.

0x27bdd4..dc compares GetAppCode with3. CompIsATitleEffect0x27c0dc and CompIsATitleOrMatteEffect0x27c134 require that effect usage and then inspect the extracted effect/IDs. A usage3 word alone does not identify a rendered precompute category.
0x27bdf4..fc compares GetAppCode with4. MultiGroup has additional _MLT_GRP attribute logic, not a proven unique numeric code here.

mediaComposer.dictionaryLimit: The MDB property dictionary identifies the named numeric property/type. Numeric meanings here are proved by named compiled native predicates and their comparisons; this bounded review did not establish a complete serialized UsageCode-name enumeration table. Do not invent meanings for all remaining integers or turn every composition role into a physical file Type option.

currentMediaMusterContext.type: It reads the associated master own UsageCode, maps1→Precompute and7→Media, and leaves other/missing codes unavailable.
currentMediaMusterContext.details: Only after proving usage1 does it read direct _IMPORTSETTING attributes and direct video-track kinds for optional RenderedEffects versus TitlesAndMatteKeys. These details and inferred effect-name labels are separate from the basic Type result. No new category extraction rule is decided by this review.

bellaRecommendationPendingUserApproval: Read one selected master own typed UsageCode after the existing complete-ID/owner qualification. For the currently reviewed layout, map explicit1 to Precompute and explicit7 to Media. Keep missing/damaged/unsupported values unavailable and keep the physical file.
Keep a small Type enum plus necessary raw usage/read-status context. Format Media or Precompute only for presentation; do not retain a full graph to preserve this scalar fact.
Do not use filename, clip-name words, audio/video descriptor kind or arbitrary first-master iteration as a substitute for the selected master recorded usage.
Keep optional precompute categories and effect/effect-sequence labels as separately retained details; they must not alter whether a correctly classified Type is known. No Bin Filter behavior changes.
limits: No executed trace of every Media Composer Type/Media Tool UI label.
No exhaustive audit of all possible UsageCode meanings, future MDB roles or version-specific schemas.
The special native zero allowance is documented with its role qualification rather than treated as a universal extra media code.
No new Bella code, app cutover or runtime parser behavior introduced.

mdvx.purpose: Bounded MDVx ordinary MDB usage/Type classification audit, including master owner, numeric read, import override, row storage, visible Kind labels, CSV and inventory filters. This is not audio/video Kind or MediaMuster Bin Filter work.
mdvx.method: Fresh installed binary SHA256 and direct arm64 usage-label/CFString decoding. Re-read exact-function disassembly previously captured for the identical binary. Independently re-read one24-byte actual MDB TOC range supplied by the corpus agent. No live app, scanner, CSV or private API execution; no production edit or media write.
mdvx.mainFinding: MDVx retains one master usage integer rather than a Media/Precompute enum. Its visible column is called Kind; labels include PRECOMP and IMPORTED but normal/missing values can be blank. The Precomputes inventory filter tests only usage1, despite a separate usage9 label. A master attribute-name prefix can replace the original usage with synthetic15.

ownerAndRead.owner: PMR-associated material/master ID bytes16..23 are passed to UIDtoBentoObj and the CompositionMobs tree at 0x100064800..84c. This is an eight-byte excerpt lookup; it does not establish Bella full-ID/qualified selected-master policy.
ownerAndRead.fileIsSeparate: The file ID is separately resolved through SourceMobs at 0x100064854..8bc. This file owner supplies Project/technical descriptor information later; it does not supply this usage classification.
ownerAndRead.property: OMFI:MOBJ:UsageCode, lookup identifier0x1033d, queried on the matched master at 0x1000648f8..908.
ownerAndRead.payloadRead: For a found property, the helper computes its24-byte TOC entry and loads the32-bit immediate value word at TOC+0x0c, instruction0x10006491c. It does not call pDataFor for this usage value.
ownerAndRead.endian: It reverses the32-bit word at0x100064920 and selects the reversed value only when _isII is false at0x100064924..928; then setDB_usageCode is called at0x100064930.
ownerAndRead.typeAndWidthLimit: The instruction consumes32 bits and assumes the immediate TOC word contains the numeric code. It does not check declared numeric type, payload length or storage kind here. The independently read representative is concrete omfi:UsageCodeType, four bytes and immediate, so that case agrees with the assumption; broader corpus/type coverage is held by the other agent.
ownerAndRead.missingMaster: Master lookup failure sets its index to-1 and skips the usage/attribute block. A fresh row keeps default0. A found master with no usage property also leaves0 unless the later import override applies.
ownerAndRead.noMediaFallback: No explicit Media value, unknown enum, source-graph usage recovery or file-descriptor classification is assigned by this missing path.

actualRepresentative.scope: One bounded raw MDB range independently re-read. Owner, full identity and declared type supplied by independent corpus agent; not a live MDVx scan.
actualRepresentative.conclusion: The current representative is a four-byte immediate numeric usage7, matching MDVx immediate32-bit assumption. Label table still maps7 to empty. This establishes compatibility here, not every layout/type/storage variant.

importOverride.path: On that same matched master, CPNT:Attributes0x1028e -> ATTR:AttrRefs0x1026b -> each attribute object -> ATTB:Name0x10257.
importOverride.exactCheck: At0x100064a78..a8c the function compares the first8 bytes with _IMPORTS and bytes6..13 with TSETTING, together matching the14-byte prefix _IMPORTSETTING. It does not require a terminating zero immediately after the prefix.
importOverride.assignment: A prefix match calls setDB_usageCode: with15 at0x100064a90..a98.
importOverride.unconditional: There is no condition on the previous usage code. This can replace recorded1,7 or any other usage when the tested master attribute name matches. This is a static control-flow conclusion, not an actual specimen claim.
importOverride.meaningLimit: No attribute value, attribute kind, import-settings contents, effect graph or media descriptor is inspected to establish this override. The row no longer distinguishes original usage from the synthetic15.
importOverride.encoding: The tested prefix is a direct ASCII-byte comparison, not a general UTF8/MacRoman display decoding step.

rowStorage.getter: DB_usageCode at0x10003156c reads a32-bit word from row+0x64.
rowStorage.setter: setDB_usageCode: at0x100031574 stores a32-bit word to row+0x64.
rowStorage.declaredRowType: Objective-C ivar/property metadata declares unsigned32 (I; TI,V_DB_usageCode).
rowStorage.availability: The row has one scalar and no separate per-usage presence/original-vs-override status. Explicit recorded0 and a fresh row with no usable usage both appear as0.

displayAndCsv.name: MDVx KindCellID, distinct from Bella Audio/Video Kind and its separate Media/Precompute Type.
displayAndCsv.table: tableView:viewForTableColumn:row:0x100050304; KindCellID branch0x100050a00..a40 subtracts1 from usage, checks index<15, and selects a CFString pointer from0x1000e94d0.
displayAndCsv.zeroSevenAndUnknown: Usage0,7,10,11,12,13,14 and values outside1..15 display empty text. Missing master/property therefore cannot be distinguished from blank-labeled ordinary values in this column. There is no explicit Media or unknown label.
displayAndCsv.csvString: tableView:NSStringValueForTableColumn:row:0x100050ce4; KindCellID branch0x1000512a8..2dc indexes the same pointer table; out-of-range takes the explicit empty literal at0x1000512e8.
displayAndCsv.export: ExportMenu genCsv0x100067bc0 calls that string method at0x100067e24. The same labels/empty text are exported, not a separately normalized Media/Precompute value.
displayAndCsv.graphLimit: UC_EFFECT and other table labels are usage labels, not actual effect names or optional effect/precompute-category extraction. This traced block does not derive an effect sequence.

inventoryFilter.flags: filterFlagPrecomputes reads byte+8, filterFlagImportedMedia byte+9, filterFlagAudioMedia byte+0x0a; exact getter receipts retained.
inventoryFilter.precompute: When the Precomputes selection is active, the test at0x10000c108..118 admits usage==1. It does NOT test9,3,6 or every non-media usage.
inventoryFilter.imported: The Imported selection admits usage==15 at0x10000c0f0..0fc; this includes the synthetic attribute override.
inventoryFilter.audioSeparate: Audio selection admits CompressionFourCC==_AUD at0x10000c12c..144; it is independent of the usage value or Kind label.
inventoryFilter.combination: When any of these three category flags is enabled, the category stage is their OR: enabled Precomputes and usage1, enabled Imported and usage15, or enabled Audio and _AUD. When all three are off this category stage imposes no exclusion. Subsequent text/portability/ID/reference filters still apply.
inventoryFilter.code9Ambiguity: A row can display UC_PRECOMPUTE_FILE for code9 yet fail a Precomputes-only category test unless another enabled category admits it. Do not infer a complete semantic precompute rule from the label table.
inventoryFilter.missing: Default usage0 does not pass Precomputes-only or Imported-only unless an enabled independent audio category also admits it.
inventoryFilter.notBinFiltering: This is MDVx ordinary inventory filtering, not Bella/MediaMuster AVB Bin Filter behavior.

headerAndOtherPaths.ordinaryMxf: Inspected MDVxMXF addInfoToItem0x1000326b4 copies clip name, Project, file UID and material UID only; no usage setter.
headerAndOtherPaths.pmrAndPhysicalSetup: The checked PMR item and unreferenced-file setup routines do not assign usage from filename or extension. Audio extension marking is separate.
headerAndOtherPaths.scope: This does not claim that every embedded parser/browser lacks usage properties or that no other app feature can inspect them.

BellaImplicationsNotApproval: Do not treat MDVx visible Kind as Bella Audio/Video Kind. Its raw usage/labels address a different master-level editorial classification.
Use separate complete identity/owner qualification and supported property typing before interpreting a usage value; a missing value is not a recorded ordinary-media code.
The PRECOMP label/filter agreement for1 and code9 label/filter mismatch are evidence of MDVx behavior, not an approved Bella classification table.
Do not copy the unconditional import-name override into the physical media/precompute Type rule merely because MDVx uses it.
No approved Kind, optional effect/precompute detail, Duration, Sample Rate or Bin Filter rule changes from this receipt.
limits: Bounded static ordinary-inventory audit, not a live app scan/export/filter test or a native Media Composer/corpus semantics audit.
No malformed, external-payload, big-endian or conflicting master usage fixture exercised here.
No comparative speed/memory benchmark. Actual property schema, supported role codes and media/precompute decisions belong the ongoing requirements review.

artifacts.role: Complete previously captured arm64 disassembly, tied to the freshly unchanged installed hash.

method: Fresh hashes of all six actual MDBs, six paired PMRs and six raw value indexes match prior evidence, with stable stat identity during reading.
Every retained identity, catalogue, physical-descriptor reference, class, usage property and traversed component reference is verified byte-for-byte against actual MDB ranges.

Full normalized PMR FileMobId selects the unique physical MOBJ in SourceMobs and ObjectSpine. Full paired PMR MasterMobId independently selects the unique nonphysical MOBJ in CompositionMobs and ObjectSpine. Missing/ambiguous match counts are retained; no recovery or alternate owner is invented by this audit.
All property names containing usage are discovered across each entire MDB. OMFI:MOBJ:UsageCode and the queried OMFI:CPNT:UsageCode are checked separately on each selected owner.

Observed MOBJ UsageCode values are decoded only with concrete omfi:UsageCodeType and four bytes as a raw unsigned little-endian enum value. This records source values without assigning Media, Precompute, effect or category labels.

Physical-row visits and distinct owners are reported separately per MDB and summed with MDB scope retained. One master associated with multiple audio/video physical files is not counted repeatedly as multiple distinct masters.

Linked other owners are reached only through each selected owner local known component tree to its exact SCLP SourceID, then qualified by full ID in the SourceMobs/ObjectSpine catalogue. No SourceID is followed recursively and no linked usage value becomes a substitute master.

Physical file, selected master, file immediate source owner and selected-master other immediate source owner have separate role counts. The latter two are owner visits per physical row and can exceed physical row counts.

Representative raw owner/class/ID/usage records retain full IDs, typed payloads, byte ranges, TOC storage and the exact physical descriptor link. Names and optional effects/categories are not needed or derived.
limits: Usage enum meaning and final Type formatting require native source evidence and user approval. Raw code values alone do not approve runtime labels or optional category/effect derivation.
All sources are established little-endian legacy MDB layouts. Unsupported types, widths, enum values, duplicate/conflicting values, absent owners and recovery cases may remain unexercised.
Distinct owner totals are per-MDB object identities summed across MDBs, not globally deduplicated full Mob IDs.
One-hop linked-source observations do not grant permission to borrow or walk arbitrary owners when a selected own value is absent.
The existing approved unique absent-master recovery policy is unchanged; the audit does not implement or alter runtime recovery.
No OldScanner oracle, production projection, physical header or essence is used. No repo, app, media or input file is written; new artifacts remain in this /private/tmp directory.

countSemantics.unresolvedAdditionalSourceTraversal: The selectedMasterGraph unresolved count 2 is per physical-row traversal, not a count of distinct unresolved SourceID claims. It does not affect the unique PMR selected-master match or direct selected-file association.

unresolvedAdditionalSourceCountClarifica.method: Bounded read-only recheck of the shared MXF/1 retained value index and paired PMR using the same full-ID catalogue and local component-tree rules. No full-corpus reparse or binary reread. Input hashes below are retained from the freshly verified Type receipt, not an additional full hash pass.
unresolvedAdditionalSourceCountClarifica.aggregateCounterUnit: Unresolved immediate source-ID claim observations per selected-master traversal for each physical PMR row.
unresolvedAdditionalSourceCountClarifica.interpretation: One distinct unresolved additional source claim is encountered for two physical rows. It does not affect their unique PMR-selected master/file matches.

currentMediaMuster.classification: MDB selected-master OMFI:MOBJ:UsageCode 1 -> MediaType::Precompute (1); 7 -> MediaType::Media (0). Unknown is -1; do not cast wire UsageCode directly to the app enum.
currentMediaMuster.displayAndCsv: Media / Precompute / em dash U+2014, generated by MediaFile::typeDisplay().
currentMediaMuster.availability: Current integer decoding and unique-property selection precede mapping. Unknown is retained if classification is unavailable. Header/source preference when eligible headers have already been read is separate from the new MDB proposal.
currentMediaMuster.optionalDetails: Precompute category uses separate attribute/track predicates; these are unnecessary solely for basic Type and remain separately retained requirements.

primarySources.scope: Corroborates original integer names; native MDB owner qualification and actual bytes establish this review's supported interpretation.

freshReceiptAndInputChecks.group: actual MDBs, sibling PMRs and retained indexes

limits: Read-only static native inspection establishes property access and predicates, not every UI Type cell.
Actual MDB audit uses retained hashed Bento indexes, actual-range verification and fresh independent full-ID owner logic; it is not an independently reimplemented entire TOC decoder.
All current selected masters use explicit 1/7. Unknown, damaged, duplicate or unsupported selected values and absent-master recovery are not exercised by this corpus.
MDVx import override is a static control-flow capability; no corpus override count or live scan/export outcome is claimed.
No measured performance gain, runtime code change or Bin Filter change.

agreedBellaRule.status: Approved by the user on 20 October 2026; not yet implemented.
agreedBellaRule.owner: The already selected qualified associated master, using agreed complete-ID and absent-master recovery rules. No preference-based replacement master search.
agreedBellaRule.numericRepresentation: Concrete supported UsageCodeType, complete four-byte numeric read in applicable object byte order, with missing/damage/conflict state separate from the integer.
agreedBellaRule.presentation: Display/export Precompute for 1, Media for 7; blank when unknown or unreadable, including unsupported/conflicting values. This replaces OldScanner's unknown em dash for Bella.
agreedBellaRule.zero: Native master predicates can accept zero only with independently proven master role. The reviewed MDB derivation does not prove master role from zero alone. No blanket zero-to-Media rule.
agreedBellaRule.retention: Compact classification enum and necessary availability, labels generated at display/export. UsageCode may remain temporary master data for other required consumers. Read once per selected master and reuse for associated physical rows during processing.
agreedBellaRule.excludedInference: Do not derive Type from physical/source UsageCode, filename, codec, name or import attribute. No complete permanent property/association graph or extra attribute/track traversal solely for Type.
agreedBellaRule.separateDecisions: Optional precompute category/effect details remain retained requirements. Layout coverage, general MDB damage policy and source/header scheduling remain separate. Small C++17 pure mapping plus checked Qt 6.5.3 typed/endian access suffices.
